responsibility: This header declares the internal generic_simplify entry points used by GENERIC folding code to invoke the simplification logic generated from match.pd. It is a narrow, non-public interface that exposes overloaded generic_simplify forms for unary, binary, ternary, and quaternary tree-code operations, separating consumers like fold_unary_loc/fold_binary_loc/fold_ternary_loc from the autogenerated implementation details in generic-match.cc.
